plan: My private value for the prize is $23, which is above the maximum possible value of $20 for other bidders. This means I can safely bid up to $20 without risk of a loss if I win, as I would still gain $3 even if I pay $20. To maximize profit, I'll bid slightly above the average expected maximum bid of $10, say $15, to increase winning chances while keeping potential payment lower.

Since there is only one round and no history to consider, I'll focus on maximizing profit by bidding just below my value. Bidding exactly my value or more is dominated as it risks zero profit or loss. I'll bid slightly lower to ensure a win if others undervalue their bids, maximizing profit margin. A bid of $16.9 maximizes potential profit without overbidding.

To maximize profit, bid slightly above the expected average of other bids, assuming they bid near their values. As values are uniformly distributed, the average is $10. Bid $15 to outbid average bids but ensure profit if winning: $19 value - $15 (likely second-highest bid) = $4 profit. Avoid dominated bids above $19 or below $10.
